Maxi-Skin, Collagen + C&A, with Verisol collagen improves skin appearance, through a Tri-Layer approach.
Skin is composed of 3 layers: Epidermis, dermis, and hypodermis.

Epidermi

Cosmetic products work primarily on the top layer of the skin, the epidermis, reinforcing skin's barrier function and improving its protective abilities. However, the visible signs of aging, like fine lines and wrinkles, decreased elasticity, firmness, and dryness, are all symptoms of what's happening beneath the surface - in the skin's dermal layer.

Over time the skin's essential supportive structure starts to break down. Collagen levels decline and elastin loses its spring causing fine lines and wrinkles to appear on the skin's surface. The older we get and the more exposed our skin has been to stressors like pollution and UV light, the more we need extra help to support smooth and supple skin.
Maxi-Skin, Collagen + C&A with Versiol collagen helps replenish natural collagen production, improving the appearance and smoothness of your skin.
